description_en: Query the inbound bandwidth and outbound bandwidth of a cloud computer, or the inbound bandwidth and outbound bandwidth for public network access of premium public bandwidth, along with their monitoring data
description_zh: 查询云电脑的流入带宽和流出带宽，或是公网精品带宽的公网访问流入带宽和流出带宽监控数据
kebab_example: aliyun ecd describe-flow-metric --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id Ecd-fwq23f130000ornp-6inxqsvcyv6z80000 --period 60 --start-time 1651817220643 --end-time 1664714703743 --metric-type intranetOutRate --instance-type desktop --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeFlowMetric

parameters.help_en: The Region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to obtain the list of Regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service (EDS)
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID, which can be either a cloud computr ID or a premium public bandwidth plan ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID，可以是云电脑ID或者公网精品带宽ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The statistic period of monitoring data. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 监控数据的统计周期。单位：秒
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
Start Time. Supported formats:

UNIX timestamp: the number of milliseconds elapsed since January 1, 1970.

Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.help_zh:
开始时间。支持的格式：

Unix时间戳：从1970年1月1日开始所经过的毫秒数。
Format格式：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
End Time. Supported formats:

UNIX timestamp: the number of milliseconds elapsed since January 1, 1970.

Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.help_zh:
结束时间。支持的格式：

Unix时间戳：从1970年1月1日开始所经过的毫秒数。
Format格式：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The type of monitoring metric. Supports monitoring data for inbound and outbound bandwidth of cloud computers, as well as inbound and outbound bandwidth for public network access of premium public bandwidth
parameters.help_zh: 监控信息类型。支持云电脑的流入与流出带宽，以及公网精品带宽的公网流入与流出带宽监控数据
parameters.name: metric_type

parameters.help_en: The instance type. You can select either cloud computer type or premium public bandwidth type. If you select cloud computer type, the `InstanceId` and `MetricType` must be filled in with a cloud computer ID and its corresponding traffic type. The same applies to premium public bandwidth
parameters.help_zh: 实例类型。可以选择云电脑类型或公网精品带宽类型。如果选择云电脑类型，则`InstanceId`与`MetricType`需对应填写云电脑ID与云电脑的流量类型，公网精品带宽同理
parameters.name: instance_type
